Extracts article:published_time, modified_time, author, section, and tags

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineObj = try createEngine(config: nil)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
debugPrint(result.metadata().article()?.publishedTime())
debugPrint(result.metadata().article()?.modifiedTime())
debugPrint(result.metadata().article()?.author())
debugPrint(result.metadata().article()?.section())
debugPrint(result.metadata().article()?.tags().count)
```
